comments replied to. Looks like I'll be 
able to finish them all today—

have such a worried look on your face~.

love sent straight to me from everyone. I 
want to look at each one properly and 
respond with all my heart♡

text_block_list.text:

loving care too♡ Maybe I'll take a little 
break♪
